svg.title: Butler asks before it acts
svg.desc: A stylized Butler window. You ask Butler to rename the screenshots on your Desktop by date. Butler looks at the Desktop and finds 24 screenshots, then asks: Rename 24 files on your Desktop? You press Allow once. Butler renames the 24 files and reports that nothing else was changed.

g.text: Rename the screenshots on my Desktop by date
Renamed 24 files. Nothing else was changed.
